readme: Registry of automations + critical outputs the health-heartbeat.ps1 watches for SILENT DEATH - an automation that stopped being scheduled (deleted/disabled), or an output that quietly went stale, WITHOUT a loud failure. Distinct from local-watchdog (browser-store staleness) and the GitHub Actions failure email (loud cloud failures). Add a new daily automation HERE when you create it. max_age_hours ~30 tolerates a late run + a weekend gap on a daily thing.
